(Search snippet content from allowed-domain search — Al Jazeera's own reporting language, 27 July 2026)

- Russia launched seven ballistic missiles and 136 drones at Ukraine overnight, hitting Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv.
- In northern Chernihiv, a Russian drone hit a supermarket, killing two people including a nine-year-old girl and wounding 25 others.
- In Kharkiv, one person was killed and 16 others required medical attention after a daytime drone attack.
- Four people were killed in a Ukrainian drone strike on the occupied city of Horlivka (Russian-occupied Donetsk region).
- At least 12 people, including two children, were hurt in a Ukrainian drone attack on Belgorod, a Russian city near the border.
